item.title: 【Helpdesk】(HELP) Username Change
item.description:
Hi!

Could a moderator please help me change my username to "Notget" or whatever?

I accidentally used my name when signing up, and I'd like to change it to a nickname to protect my privacy. Since there's no option to do this in the settings, I appreciate your help with this. Or just delete this account so I can create a new one.

Thanks in advance!
